title: I made a souls-like game with GPT-6 Astra
author: Fearless_Brilliant51
selftext:
I prototyped a game with souls-like comabt in my game

And of course, I had to make the Doom spell too:  
[https://x.com/code3ater/status/2096299550386634949](https://x.com/code3ater/status/2096299550386634949)

comments.author: Gigaslavx
comments.body:
Sick mate looks great how much did it cost like a whole weekly x20 so 50 bucks equivalent? Cheers

Are you doing it for yourself or commercially I mean with the barrier to entry so low the market must be overwhelmed with supply

replies.author: Fearless_Brilliant51
replies.body:
It was a game idea I had but didn't start working on, got access to Astra last night and dropped the spec and worked my way from there. I did use a weekly reset so I maxed out the 5 hour usage around 4 times on the plus plan. Estimated cost is around **$64.24** worth of usage.  
  
Commercially eventually. This is just a prototype for now, mainly to see if the idea and combat actually work before I commit to building it properly.

I’ve also got another game that’s very close to being finished and released, so I probably won’t be working on this one seriously for a while.

replies.author: Gigaslavx
replies.body: Thank you for information! Price wise I meant not api/token equivalent but from pov of sub, so only 4 x 5-hour plus segments (get 6 of those per week so about what less than 5 bucks)? That's quite reasonable. What reasoning level was it if you don't mind me asking low/medium? Was it like 15-30 minutes every 5 hour window?

replies.author: Fearless_Brilliant51
replies.body:
It was on x high, I kept giving a batch of fixes/features every prompt so it maxed out within 1 very large prompt most of the time.

It took an average of 40 ish mins every window and delivered quite a lot everytime. From what I can see its doing much more, much quicker than GPT Sol

comments.author: ffuub
comments.body: why did you post dark souls gameplay tho, can you show the game you did?

replies.author: Fearless_Brilliant51
replies.body: My bad dude! I may have accidentally created dark souls from scratch (and made no mistakes)

replies.author: Fearless_Brilliant51
replies.body: Yeah, its a very rough prototype I put together in less than 12 hours. Its all running on threejs rn but I will be porting it to an engine when I can actually start working on it.

comments.author: ZerkyXii
comments.body: Someone posted a game earlier and it looks just like this

replies.author: Fearless_Brilliant51
replies.body: I just prompted for it to make the prototype in a simple voxel style so if anybody else promoted the same thing it would look the same. But I am curious to see it if you could share it

comments.author: Exact_Bother8304
comments.body: cool, looks like a cubeworld that I was waiting for!

comments.author: SurvivalHermit
comments.body: This is a really good prototype. the hit area on the ground the stun attack the movement is good. the only thing i would say I dont like is the range of the attacks makes it feel like you are standing too close to the enemy when fighting. I hope more people start to make games with low poly or blocky art like this but with high fidelity movement and animations. Chasing photorealism i think really set game dev back a lot.
